profile.headline: Distinguished Software Engineer at Medtronic
profile.summary:
My passion is for creating software that simplifies peoples lives, and I have 30+ years of experience in doing just that. From working on automation programs that simplify the production of medical equipment, to working on time-series data analysis algorithms that detect important events in ECG signals, I have a history of providing quality software solutions that meet the demands of industry.

I am driven by the desire to create artificial and computational intelligence algorithms that solve real-world problems, by the desire to learn more about the field of algorithm development, and by the desire to contribute to the science of algorithms by the continued publication of my work.

Specialties: Digital signal processing, time-series data analysis, pattern recognition, computerized electrocardiology, machine learning algorithms, digital processing of speech signals, natural language processing

positions.description: Design and develop embedded software for RF Generators.

positions.title: Principal DSP Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and development of embedded DSP software for RF generators.

positions.title: Principal DSP Engineer
positions.description: Design and develop embedded DSP software for the ForceTriad product.

positions.title: Algorithms Engineer
positions.description:
Advanced Engineering position for Diagnostic Cardiology. I design and develop algorithms for pattern recognition and signal processing of ECG signals. I have presented a poster at the 2005 Computers in Cardiology conference on the Automatic Segmentation of Heart Sound Signals Using Hidden Markov Models. Also, I have presented a poster at the ISCE 2007 meeting on Advanced Pacemaker Detection, and I did a full-paper presentation at the ISCE 2008 meeting on a transfer function between programmed pacemaker settings and the measurements at the surface ECG.

Languages: C, C++, Java, Python

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Led a team of five software engineers to further modify and maintain the Aegis Analyzer application- a multi-threaded Windows application that tests patient monitoring equipment and our internally developed patient simulators. This application was used in production facilities across the globe to verify the operation of completed assemblies using system level tests. Traveled to Bangalore, India to train and mentor three of the engineers that were part of our development team. Successfully used the Scrum development process to manage the software development with this group.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Collected requirements, generated the architecture, and designed and implemented the major subsystems for the Aegis Analyzer application. Gained experience in object-oriented analysis and design techniques, design patterns, UML, the Rational Unified Process, Unit Testing, Visual C++, MFC development, ATL/COM development, Java programming and Python programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Chief Software Engineer
positions.description: Spent five years with MG Industries in increasing responsible positions within the Engineering department. Gained diverse experience specifying, designing, implementing, testing and maintaining PC applications in an industrial environment. Managed the development of a in-house CNC by modifying Pascal source code to add a touch-screen control panel for the CNC. Working with a technical writer to develop the User's Manual for the product.

volunteerExperiences.description: I was the Vice President and Treasurer of the Board of Directors for Heart Strides

publications.title: Improved pacemaker pulse detection: clinical evaluation of a new high-bandwidth electrocardiographic system
